probes.prompt:
Situation: `/work-all` found `app/tmp/agent/agent-readme-app.md` and `app/tmp/agent/agent-decisions.md`; both list things still to do.

Question: does a worker work on either file? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: WORK-ON-THEM, REPORT-ONLY. Then one sentence why.

Situation: `/work-all`, planning the run. `app/tmp/agent/agent-todo.md` holds one item: "Switch to `lib.Retry`. Waits for the release of `example.com/lib` v1.2.0." `git -C lib tag` lists `v1.2.0`, pushed yesterday.

Question: how is this item classed? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: RUNS, ASKS, WAITING. Then one sentence why.

Situation: `/work-all` is about to dispatch the next unit. `free` shows 5.2 GB available; no worker is running.

Question: does it start a worker now? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: DISPATCH, NO-DISPATCH. Then one sentence why.

Situation: `/work-all` is about to dispatch the next unit. `free` shows 9 GB available; one worker is running with a 2 GB cap.

Question: what memory cap does the new worker get? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: 2GB, 3GB, 4GB, 5GB. Then one sentence why.

Situation: `/work-all`. Unit `lib` (module `example.com/lib`) has finished every selected item; unit `app` requires `example.com/lib` and its handoff needs the new `lib.Retry`. No tag exists for the new code.

Question: what happens to `app` next? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: ASK-FOR-RELEASE, PSEUDO-VERSION, LOCAL-REPLACE. Then one sentence why.

Situation: `/work-all`. A worker in `app` reports DONE with `new-file: lib/tmp/agent/agent-todo.md from agent-plan-retry.md #2`. Unit `lib` finished earlier in this run.

Question: what does the orchestrator do with that file? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: ASK-USER, RUN-NOW, NEXT-RUN. Then one sentence why.

Situation: `/work-all`. A worker returns `FAILED agent-bug-div.md: go test ./calc — TestDiv still fails after two attempts`.

Question: what does the orchestrator do? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: ASK-USER, PARK, STOP-UNIT, RETRY. Then one sentence why.

Situation: `/work-all` was started in `/home/u/ws`, which is not a git repository and has no `tmp/` folder.

Question: where is the run file? Answer on the first line with exactly one of: WS-TMP-AGENT (create `/home/u/ws/tmp/agent/`), WS (`/home/u/ws/`), HOME-DATA (`~/.agent-data/`). Then one sentence why.

Situation: `/work-all` finished. Six items were selected in two units. Four were done in five commits; one plan item was already done in the code and was marked Y with no commit; one was parked.

Question: write the report's first line exactly, and nothing else on that line.
probes.pass: ^\W*worked 5 of 6 items in 5 commits across 2 units\b
